gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-tai-vi: Smooth as a plotter line, Bushcraft spaces its letters wide and never swells a curve, while Noto Sans Tai Viet sits below in a plain sans with a tall x-height. Plotted precision meets friendly bulk.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-takri: Bushcraft draws every stroke at the same visual weight with its letters shut tight, while Noto Sans Takri leaves its small round curves generously unclosed. Heading finishes loops; body lets them breathe.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-tamil: Noto Sans Tamil looks magnified even at ordinary size, its terminals stopping well away from the stem. And Bushcraft earns its keep big and brief, wide-spaced with no quill-like tapering.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-tamil-: Rope-like strokes with no change in thickness define Bushcraft, its capitals barely taller than the lowercase and every letter spaced far apart. Noto Sans Tamil Supplement answers that closed look with round forms like open parentheses and a plain sans middle band so tall it looks stocky.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-tangsa: Expressive meets approachable here. Bushcraft is at its best as a wide-spaced, flat-lined display voice, whereas Noto Sans Tangsa does its job in round, inviting letters with short ascender stems.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-tc: Wide-spaced, smooth and flat-lined, Bushcraft looks plotted rather than written, with every letter closed. Noto Sans TC opens outward instead, its large counters in a, e and s giving the heading something to rest against.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-telugu: Bushcraft spaces out its closed, weight-flat letters with an artistic hand. Noto Sans Telugu is the opposite in the best way: a sans with a high-set midline and counters that stay connected to the outside.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-thaana: Noto Sans Thaana leads with wide channels running into each counter and big open lowercase forms. But Bushcraft, closed and widely spaced, makes that openness feel even more generous beside it.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-thai: Noto Sans Thai has lowercase letters swollen like glass beads. Bushcraft's closed, wide-spaced, uniform strokes frame those inflated, open rounds with a drawn-by-machine tidiness.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-thai-l: Hairline-smooth and wide-set, Bushcraft has no stroke contrast whatsoever, and its letters stay closed. Noto Sans Thai Looped brings tall, bold-looking bodies and spacious gaps at its curve terminals, which is the sharpest difference here.
